quotations.old_english: Ðá nam he fif stánas on his herdebelig
quotations.english: then he took five stones in his shepherd's bag

source_text: hirde-belg, -belig, es; m. A shepherd's bag :-- Ðá nam he fif stánas on his herdebelig then he took five stones in his shepherd's bag, Blickl. Homl. 31, 17.
